company.formedBy: HSFPL was incorporated on 12 Dec 2022 as the resulting company of a composite Scheme of Arrangement (ss. 230-232 and s. 66, Companies Act 2013) under which the FMCG (packaged snacks/food) undertakings of Haldiram Snacks Pvt Ltd (HSPL, Delhi family) and Haldiram Foods International Pvt Ltd (HFIPL, Nagpur family) were DEMERGED into HSFPL, with HSPL's shareholders receiving 56% and HFIPL's shareholders 44% of HSFPL. Milestones: CCI notice filed 14 Mar 2023, CCI approval 3 Apr 2023; HFIPL board approved the scheme 15 Jul 2023; NCLT Chandigarh first-motion order reported as 19 Jan 2024 (CA(CAA) 42/Chd/Hry/2023, snippet only); creditor meetings 28 Mar 2024; second-motion petition CP(CAA) No. 10/Chd/Hry/2024 with an order dated 01 Jul 2024 (snippet; not confirmed whether that order is the final sanction). Completion was announced publicly by CEO Krishan Kumar Chutani in April 2025 (The Hitavada 9 Apr 2025). The scheme's appointed date and the date it became effective (ROC filing) were not found. Because this was a demerger, HSPL and HFIPL themselves were not dissolved: MCA-mirror sites still show both as Active, and the restaurant businesses remained outside HSFPL.
company.ipo: No DRHP for Haldiram Snacks Food was found. SEBI, NSE and BSE could not be checked directly because those sites were blocked. A secondary IPO-news site said in June 2026 that no DRHP had been filed. What is reported: (a) Jan-Mar 2025 coverage of the Temasek deal presented the stake sales as pre-IPO, with a listing expected in roughly 12-24 months (Lapaas Voice: 18-24 months at USD 10-12 bn). (b) Retail-broker and IPO-news sites (Angel One, IPOCentral, about Sep 2025) said the board had started discussing issue size and timing, targeting a Rs 4,000-5,000 crore issue (fresh issue plus OFS) at a USD 8-10 bn valuation, first for FY26 and later 2027. No timing has been confirmed by the company, and none of this comes from a primary source. Confidence: low.
company.excluded: NOT part of HSFPL: (1) The Kolkata family business, Haldiram Bhujiawala Ltd (brand 'Prabhuji', from the Rameshwar Lal / Prabhu Shankar Agarwal line). Its plants are in Hooghly district, West Bengal (Singur; Ghanashyampur, NH-2, PIN 712409), with 3 facilities of 6,035 MTPA per CARE 2023. An IPAB order of 26 Apr 2013 removed its 'Haldiram Bhujiawala' registration. The 'Hooghly' plant on Wikipedia's plant list very probably belongs to this Kolkata business and is left out here. (2) Bikaner-origin relatives' companies: Bikaji Foods International (listed) and Bikanervala, which are separate brands and families. (3) Delhi-family companies outside the FMCG demerger: Haldiram Marketing Pvt Ltd, the resulting company of a separate NCLT Chandigarh scheme (second-motion hearing 2 May 2025) that took in Haldiram Manufacturing Co Pvt Ltd (Kherki Daula), Haldiram Ethnic Foods Pvt Ltd (Mohan Co-op Industrial Estate, New Delhi), Haldi Ram Products, HR Bakers, Haldiram Retail and Dreamcann Foods. These cover the restaurant, retail, sweets and bakery businesses. Also outside: Haldiram India Pvt Ltd (the trademark plaintiff in the 2024 Delhi HC 'well-known mark' case; its relationship to HSFPL, such as a brand licence, is not public) and Haldiram Snacks Manufacturing Pvt Ltd (CIN U15490DL2021PTC390449). (4) Nagpur-family restaurants and base kitchens, which haldirams.com lists as operated by OAM Industries (India) Pvt Ltd. (5) The residual HSPL and HFIPL companies themselves. Reports that the merger included 'Bikaner operations' (Angel One / IPO blogs) are not supported by CCI, NCLT or CRISIL.
